snippet.title: v8.3 Flickers of a Spacetime Warp Trailer — Honkai Impact 3rd
snippet.description:
v8.3 Flickers of a Spacetime Warp coming soon! Helia's new S-rank battlesuit "Planar Armament: Warped Spacetime" debuts!
Part 2 Main Story Chapter IX: If Destiny Concludes Today, featured event "Bon Voyage! Toward Blessings and Wishes!", a new outfit, and more exciting content to be released! Stay tuned!
Voice Artists:
Nahralab: Arisa Sakuraba
Coralie 6626 Planck: Saya Aizawa
Leylah: Yuki Nakashima
Dreamseeker: Yuki Nakashima
Erdős Helia: Yui Kondo
